header: # MOCK-APPLY node fixture `p8test_desktop_home` (HQ 2026-10-27 ruling 7; HQ batch-8 ruling 5) for mount_shares_desktop.
# The define writes its two scripts into /home/<username>/Desktop (mount_shares_desktop.pp:7-8) and never declares it:
# on a desktop the user's first graphical login creates ~/Desktop (xdg-user-dirs), and no class of the code tree owns
# it. This declares the fixture user p8testuser (never a real account) with that directory, as a first login leaves it.
# Lifted by: a first graphical login of the user on a lab desktop node (xdg-user-dirs creates ~/Desktop)
node_fixture.scope_evidence: user[p8testuser] (fixture account, managehome) and file[/home/p8testuser/Desktop] (directory owned by p8testuser, as xdg-user-dirs on first graphical login would leave it) - both only provide the parent dir the define writes into (mount_shares_desktop.pp desktop_dir); neither touches the define's two file resources shares-mount.sh/shares-unmount.sh; within the stated stand-in
